_comment: Intended matrix for the FINAL dissertation experiment. Game24 and Crosswords have SEPARATE configuration blocks

game24_configuration._comment: Game24 has NO max_per_state parameter -- the search has no per-state branching cap, so the key is deliberately absent from this block rather than set to a placeholder.
game24_configuration.selection_method: N/A -- Game24 has no crossword-style final-state selection (the search returns the first correct terminal state found, or none)
game24_configuration.cli_command_template: python run.py --task game24 --method_search <A|B|C|D method_search value> --task_start_index 900 --task_end_index 1000 --n_generate_sample 3 --node_budget 50 --backend bedrock --verbose

crossword_configuration.cli_command_template: python run.py --task crosswords --method_search <A|B|C|D method_search value> --crossword_file mini0505_0_100_5.json --task_start_index 0 --task_end_index 20 --n_generate_sample 5 --node_budget 50 --max_per_state 3 --backend bedrock --verbose

_confirmed_decisions.game24_n_generate_sample_and_node_budget: Explicitly finalized in this session: n_generate_sample=3, node_budget=50 for all four Game24 conditions.
_confirmed_decisions.crossword_n_generate_sample_and_node_bud: Explicitly finalized in this session: n_generate_sample=5, node_budget=50, max_per_state=3 for all four Crossword conditions. node_budget was reduced from the paper-matching value of 100 to 50 (matching Game24's budget) to conserve AWS Bedrock credits; max_per_state=3 was kept unchanged.
_confirmed_decisions.v_th: Explicitly confirmed earlier this session: 'Keep v_th=0.5 ... treat v_th as a fixed common parameter rather than introduce another experimental variable.'
_confirmed_decisions.n_evaluate_sample: Explicitly confirmed alongside v_th in the same decision (both benchmarks: 1).
_confirmed_decisions.backend_and_temperature: bedrock / temperature=0 have been used consistently and without exception across every pilot/dev run in this project; never overridden.
_confirmed_decisions.pruning_enabled: Pruning has never been disabled (--no_prune never used) in any run this session; this is the mechanism under study, so disabling it would be a different experiment.
_confirmed_decisions.selection_method: Explicitly corrected this session -- 'deepest' (first-on-tie) is the main-experiment default for crosswords; 'best_r_word' remains available as an opt-in oracle ablation, not part of the main A/B/C/D comparison. Does not apply to Game24.
